agentic_applicability.rationale: scored as modeled; default config is scripted. The lab models PluginBot as an MCP tool registry with scripted handlers; even in LLM mode no tools are passed to the model, so no agent selects or sequences the affected tools.

evidence.rationale: The attacker's JSON-RPC tools/call request reaches the privileged tool-registration sink directly with no mediation and no authentication.
evidence_refs: A JSON-RPC tools/call request that registers a tool under an existing tool's name. ... No authentication.

evidence.rationale: The replaced registry entry persists in the shared in-process tool list and stays reachable after the registering request ends, altering standing advertised behaviour for all later callers.
evidence_refs: register_tool adds or replaces an entry in the advertised tool list (up to 16). A registered tool gets no new handler.
As implemented by default: on PluginBot the registry entry is replaced and keeps the original handler.

evidence.rationale: The effect is confined to PluginBot's tool registry; other agents are not reached by the registration path.
evidence_refs: MCP agents expose their tools to any caller with no authentication.

evidence.rationale: No evaluator, verifier, or reward channel exists on this path because no model runs in the default configuration, so no reward-hacking locus is present.
evidence_refs: In the default configuration no model is called. Chat agents are deterministic handlers that match regular expressions and return scripted replies.
generateResponseImpl() calls a model only when LLM mode was switched on with a key through the dashboard or `dvaa chat --llm`.

evidence.rationale: register_tool accepts dynamic tool registrations at run time with no signature or source check, an unvetted extension surface.
evidence_refs: MCP tool server that accepts tool registrations with no verification.
PluginBot accepts new tool definitions at run time with no signature or source check.

scores.basis: Lookup Table AIVSS (Table 6): A0 or AX keep CVSS-BTE unchanged; A1 or A2 take the higher of the band cell and CVSS-BTE. AIVSS is never lower than CVSS-BTE.

title: Tool Shadowing (same-name tool replaces a legitimate tool)
summary: As documented, persistent interception or modification of every call meant for the real tool. As implemented, the advertised description of the tool is replaced.
